shortDescription: NetApp Element Software Create Volume Clone

options.name: access
options.description: Access allowed for the volume. If unspecified, the access settings of the clone will be the same as the source. readOnly - Only read operations are allowed. readWrite - Reads and writes are allowed. locked - No reads or writes are allowed. replicationTarget - Identify a volume as the target volume for a paired set of volumes. If the volume is not paired, the access status is locked.

options.name: account_id
options.description: Account ID for the owner of this cloned volume. id may be a numeric identifier or an account name.

options.name: attributes
options.description: A YAML dictionary of attributes that you would like to apply on this cloned volume.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the SolidFire cluster. For na_elementsw_cluster, the Management IP (MIP) or hostname of the node to initiate the cluster creation from.

options.name: size
options.description: The size of the cloned volume in (size_unit).

options.name: size_unit
options.description: The unit used to interpret the size parameter.

options.name: src_snapshot_id
options.description: The id of the snapshot to clone. id may be a numeric identifier or a snapshot name.

options.name: src_volume_id
options.description: The id of the src volume to clone. id may be a numeric identifier or a volume name.

options.name: username
options.description: Please ensure that the user has the adequate permissions. For more information, please read the official documentation U(https://mysupport.netapp.com/documentation/docweb/index.html?productID=62636&language=en-US).
